# EMBERFALL — Copilot Instructions

Follow the root `AGENTS.md`, `README.md`, `engineering/CODING_AGENT_ROADMAP.md` and `engineering/MASTER_CODING_AGENT_PROMPT.md`.

Before implementing, inspect repository state and current tasks. Do not invent unresolved P0 mechanics listed in `engineering/OPEN_DECISIONS.md`. Keep gameplay deterministic and Android-independent, use data-driven content, test each card/effect, and follow Maestro v0.3 Grounding → Momentum → Mastery → Repetition. The reviewer must be independent of the builder and review the exact candidate SHA.

Concept images are art-direction references only; do not copy their generated UI text into production. Do not describe unimplemented features as completed. Never publish, merge, deploy or perform destructive operations without explicit human approval.
